method: Read all 258 cached PDF layout-text files and count numbered question headings containing Short Answer, Multiple Choice, or the individually inspected source typos Short, Muliple Choice, and Multiple Choic. Compare the per-packet multiset of printed numbers with original corpus records.

difference.resolution: Toss-up 5 is recovered by the source-backed structural correction on PDF page 3.

limitation: Heading-count agreement does not prove correct classification, mathematical transcription, or complete field boundaries. Independent visual source review is still required for every question.
